answer.explanation: The uploader's OUTPUT_BUCKET is set to the non-existent bucket 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca' in the live configuration (last modified 22:14:52Z, just before the window), and the committed SAM template matches it. Commit c7da0ab (22:13:53Z UTC) changed the value from !Ref OutputBucket to that literal, and 13a4995 made the same change earlier; an intervening revert was itself reverted. Every PutObject in the window fails with NoSuchBucket, so uploads are failing. The live config and template agree, so the root cause is the IaC change, not drift.
